They also want the estimated total payable amount. We need to get the list of all airports, then pick the first and last. Then call get_flight_cost with travel_from=first, travel_to=last, travel_date=2026-10-31, travel_class=business. That returns cost in USD. Then we need to provide estimated total payable amount. But what about other costs? Possibly insurance? But they didn't mention insurance. They just want estimated total payable amount. So likely just the flight cost. But maybe we need to consider taxes? The get_flight_cost returns cost in USD. So we can provide that. There's no other cost. So we call get_flight_cost.
